usage: Use 寫作 to talk about the activity or skill of writing, especially in school, exams, or creative work.
It is a neutral, everyday word and sounds natural in both spoken and written Cantonese.
Common in collocations like 寫作技巧, 寫作比賽, and 寫作能力.
When talking about hobbies, it can mean writing stories, essays, blogs, or other creative pieces.
